Civis Platform is a modern, end-to-end data management, analytics, and AI platform—purpose-built for the public sector in a simple, scalable SaaS environment.

With Civis Platform, in-house public sector data teams can seamlessly integrate their data, build and manage data warehouses, develop machine learning and AI models, and deploy reports—all within a single platform. This eliminates the need for fragmented SaaS tools or complex cloud service configurations.

Civis Platform deploys in hours—not months—and includes services onboarding and training tailored for public sector teams to ensure successful deployments from day one.
